name: Johan Van Overtveldt - § 27 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text: 27. Calls on the ECB to reduce the EU’s financial dependence on US assets by strengthening the international role of the euro; calls on the ECB to be prepared for a possible ‘sell America’ scenario, in which public and private institutions would sell off US assets on a large scale in the context of increasing US aggression;
